title: Domain BeamSystem primitive

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Root BeamSystem export is re-exported from the migrated implementation

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript BeamSystem modules, including root re-export identity, independent constructor behavior, exact JSON serialization, duplicate-node handling, total length, mutation/chaining, defaults, Unicode values and constructor errors.

tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for delegated beam total length
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The strict TypeScript declarations describe the existing JavaScript BeamSystem contract without adding runtime behavior.
FEM element systems and application-level beam systems remain outside this slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic beam-system membership, distinct-node tracking, total length and serialization primitive only.
